about: Token targets and the quality guard for node scripts/bench/run.mjs --check. Token counts are o200k_base. Sources: the token usage report of 2026-10-27, measured at 18abe10 (its figures are quoted in each target), and the MEM-106 to MEM-117 contracts. A target is never loosened to make a run pass.

guard.why: on-topic recall on the tool path, zero drop
precision on the tool path, zero drop
on-topic recall on the per-prompt hook, zero drop
precision on the per-prompt hook, zero drop

latency.why: recall p95 within 10 percent or 5 ms of the --latency-vs commit, both run interleaved in the same process; the tolerance is the proposal under review

hook_min_score.rule: the highest per-prompt bar in 6 to 8 that keeps every on-topic hit the baseline finds, at both levels; prompts under 4 words and continuation phrases are not recalled
hook_min_score.how: the scripts/bench harness (measureQuality) with recall.hook_min_score set on the seeded vault and short prompts skipped

targets.what: memev_get on the largest note, at most 2,500 tokens (report: 98,649)
memev_get on the largest note, at most 8,000 characters
memev_recall at limit 1000, at most 1,300 tokens (report: 138,407)
memev_recall at limit 1000 is no larger than at limit 10
bus_unread with 200 unread messages, at most 1,300 tokens (report: 30,285)
memev_list on a vault with many sessions, at most 50 entries per page
share of off-topic and continuation prompts that inject anything, at most 0.45 (report: 14 to 17 of 20 today, 9 of 20 at min score 6)
mean tokens injected per on-topic prompt, at most 289 (report baseline)
mean tokens injected per off-topic prompt, at most 83 (report: min score 6)
items injected again later in the same session: none
session journal or contract draft items injected per prompt: none
the protocol text, at most 200 tokens (report: 562)
the protocol appears in exactly one channel per session (report: two)
fixed overhead, Claude Code default, empty vault, at most 1,000 (report: 1,804)
session start after a compaction carries no protocol text
session start after a compaction is at most the resume card
default tools/list as the model sees it, at most 600 tokens (report: 4,150)
fixed overhead with every tool counted, at most 1,100 (report: 5,484)
a 6-hit memev_recall result, at most 450 tokens (report: 761)
the 6-hit recall still returns 6 hits
